name: Electrified Gate AP OLD

stealth.note: (master) or @Check[perception|dc:50|traits:secret] (legendary) to notice the bypass button hidden in a skull's eye socket

description: A warded metal gate electrocutes anyone who touches the gate without pressing the bypass button.
disable: DC 47 Thievery (legendary) to destroy the ward, Dispel Magic (8th rank; counteract DC 47) to counteract the ward, or press the bypass button
reset: The trap resets automatically if triggered, after 1 minute if the bypass button is pressed, or after 15 minutes if disabled or counteracted.

generalAbilities.name: Electrocution
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the gate directly or with a tool

Effect The trap deals (8d10+40) Electricity Damage damage to the triggering creature (Basic DC 46 Reflex Saving Throw).
